title: Solara V3 PC: Free Windows Level 7 Execution Tutorial
excerpt: How to configure Windows Defender exclusions, extract Solara bootstrapper, and fix injection crash errors.
content:
### Overview

Solara is a lightweight, Level 7 bytecode Roblox executor built for 64-bit Windows.

### Requirements
- Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
- Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 Redistributables
- Antivirus exclusion for Solara folder

### Installation
1. Extract the Solara.zip archive to a dedicated folder (e.g. `C:\Solara`).
2. Add the folder as an exclusion in Windows Defender.
3. Launch `SolaraBootstrapper.exe` as Administrator.
4. Join any Roblox experience and press Attach.
